local_inputs.scope: Inherited product/comparator context, not new primary evidence.
Original conditional rank5, illustrative cost/time and retained-value premise.

evidence_rows.finding: Exact reference is biotin-capped D-Phe followed by YIGSSSR, assembled as mIGF-Gel; paper reports transparent gel at 0.4 wt%.
evidence_rows.limit: Full graphical end-group, salt, purity, batch and commercial presentation not qualified in this lane.

evidence_rows.finding: New application expressly names the exact derivative, product/hydrogel and tissue-repair uses including corneal injury and persistent epithelial defects.
Earlier A publication and B grant differ: broad independent X wording in A; granted B claim1 incorporates SEQ ID NOs1-3.
evidence_rows.claim_scope_rule: Use granted text rather than inheriting the application wording.

evidence_rows.finding: Old grant description[0029] explicitly names the exact Arg-ending peptide, but original sequence-list SEQ ID1 ends Ala.
evidence_rows.sequence_list_SEQ_ID_1: Tyr Ile Gly Ser Ser Ser Ala
evidence_rows.interpretation: Exact prior description is established; no conclusion on literal coverage, correction, validity, infringement or FTO. Not evidence of a wrong 2026 study batch.

evidence_rows.finding: Accessible indexes show distinct family records, each with a CN entry; newer application does not list the older priority.
Nankai IP portal corroborates the exact newer application, applicant, inventors and dates.
Old grant cover names Nankai as patentee and three inventors; some names across old/new records overlap with paper authorship.
evidence_rows.scope: Publication provenance; neither ddiscov ownership nor present contractual rights inferred.

evidence_rows.finding: Older grant reports refrigerated gels remained in gel state without precipitation for at least one month.

FDA ophthalmic-quality overview remains draft/nonbinding/not for implementation; listed issues include microbiology, impurities/particulates, container delivery, stability and optional release/dissolution controls.
FDA Q23 addresses ophthalmic drug sterility through shelf life and prevention of harmful microbial contamination during multidose use, with container and manufacturing controls.
evidence_rows.application_to_mIGF: Conditional context if developed as a U.S. ophthalmic drug; no product-specific regulatory determination.

evidence_rows.finding: Official bibliography/dossier and graphical-figure attempts did not yield substantive records.
Prior ranking supplied a conditional fifth place and illustrative local-product/active-comparator envelope dependent on a suitable model.

Useful repair or practical treatment-burden advantage against an applicable insulin product is the value premise; equivalent outcomes without meaningful practical advantage weaken the financial route.
evidence_rows.decision_basis: Decision inference from preserved comparator/product premise, not a new clinical result.

evidence_rows.finding: Exact sequence disclosure, assembled material, clinical effect, quality-controlled product, legal access and retained value are separate questions.
evidence_rows.decision_basis: Integration judgment; does not imply biological failure or asset availability.

claim_decisions.claim: The original mIGF sequence is a newly invented unclaimed asset for ddiscov
claim_decisions.reason: Exact prior disclosure and named university records exist; no ownership transferred by publication.

claim_decisions.claim: The earlier B grant unambiguously covers or excludes the Arg-ending article
claim_decisions.reason: Granted SEQ-ID language and original Arg/Ala discrepancy require a substantive legal/record resolution; no silent harmonization.

claim_decisions.claim: Hosted current labels or an institutional catalog establish present title, a license or global freedom to operate
claim_decisions.reason: Bounded source records do not establish these distinct propositions.

claim_decisions.claim: Reported refrigerated gel-state stability establishes an ophthalmic shelf life
claim_decisions.reason: Physical state does not establish sterility, potency, product delivery or in-use quality.

claim_decisions.claim: A narrower readiness-only tranche retains the original rank5 at the same price
claim_decisions.reason: Reduced information yield requires a new marginal comparison even without price expansion.

claim_decisions.claim: mIGF must be superior on every efficacy endpoint to have value
claim_decisions.reason: Comparable useful repair with a substantial verified practical advantage could be valuable, but no such human advantage is established.

claim_decisions.claim: Failure of a poorly qualified delivery/model route proves the molecule failed
claim_decisions.reason: Such a negative can be uninformative scientifically while still stopping investment because the route cannot buy the useful answer.

claim_decisions.claim: The capture findings justify switching the selected candidate or promoting development rank
claim_decisions.reason: Sharper provenance and product risks alter conditions; actual rights, costs and comparative benefit remain unqualified.
